title: Additive chart section identifications and formulas
statement: Let A be a commutative local ring, C its maximal-ideal adic completion, U open in Spec A, q:Y → U, s:E → Spec C, E affine, and D the supplied overlap identification [def-sbc-punctured-completion-matching-sections]. Let t ∈ ℕ and f:Fin t → A with D(f_i) contained in U and V_i=(q followed by U inclusion)⁻¹D(f_i) affine. Use the fixed completed and chart section modules [def-sbc-punctured-completion-chart-section-modules]. There exist A-linear alpha_i:(Γ(E,top))_(f_i) ≃ C tensor_A M_i and additive d_i:C tensor_A M_i ≃ Γ(O,p⁻¹V_i), where O=Y ×_U (Spec C restricted to U), p:O → Y. The alpha_i commute with the localized C-action. Their generator values satisfy d_i(alpha_i(m/1))=restriction of D.toCompleted^*(m), and d_i(1 tensor n)=p^*n. Also d_i(z x)=the structural C-section of z times d_i(x). The alpha_i and d_i are constructed together, not supplied arbitrarily.

proof.text: Use the existing canonical joint-existence theorem exists_chart_completed_localizations, which constructs alpha and d together and gives all four compatibility clauses. The arbitrary-alpha theorem is retired, not reproved.
